80441.subject: Ukončenie posielania ponúk emailom
80441.body:
Dobrý deň,

všimli sme si, že ste za posledných 6 mesiacov neklikli na žiadnu z pracovných ponúk, ktoré Vám posielame. Mrzí nás, že Vás ponuky na Profesia.sk nezaujali. Z tohto dôvodu Vám preto posielanie ponúk e-mailom s názvom Pracovné ponuky e-mailom Košice, na dohodu (brigády), vypíname. Ak máte aktivované aj iné posielania ponúk emailom, tie Vám budú chodiť naďalej bez zmeny.

Ak by ste mali záujem dostávať najčerstvejšie pracovné ponuky aj naďalej, ponúkame Vám 3 dôvody, prečo si zasielanie ponúk znovu aktivovať:
  1. Pošleme Vám ponuky podľa výšky platu, ktorý si určíte
  2. Môžete si vybrať ponuky podľa vzdialenosti od Vášho bydliska
  3. O ponukách sa dozviete hneď

Dear professionals, we are pleased to share the September edition of the PFI Monthly Research Report. This issue explores key themes shaping global macro, financial markets, Czech M&A, private equity, banking and real estate — with a common thread running through it: as central banks stop "looking through" inflation, the diversification and valuation assumptions built into portfolios are being tested. In this issue of PFI Monthly you will find: Global macro – Why three major central banks (ECB, Fed, BoJ) tightened within eight days as they grew less willing to look through an energy-driven inflation shock, and what that means for stock-bond correlations; plus a six-factor fundamental framework — interest-rate differentials, inflation expectations, growth dynamics, the current account, NIIP and fiscal credibility — for analysing exchange rates. Financial markets – A contribution analysis decomposing the S&P 500's 1,031% rally since the 2009 low into revenue growth, margin expansion and multiple expansion, with revenue growth likely the only sustainable driver ahead; why longer-dated US Treasury yields at multi-decade highs are a warning equities are not yet pricing; and a study of why temperament, not intelligence, separates good investors from bad. Czech M&A – CVC's minority (~30%) investment in Prague-based CDN77 via its Strategic Opportunities platform, at a reported USD 1.9–2bn valuation — the largest PE deal in CEE technology this year. Private equity – How European hostels moved from a specialist niche to an institutional asset class, with Brookfield, Apollo, King Street and others deploying billions into a fragmented, consolidating market. Banking – The "fintech free-rider" debate: as branches close and neobanks like Revolut scale, should fintechs help fund the physical infrastructure the system still depends on? Real estate – Why the risk premium on privately held CRE has compressed to near cyclical lows, leaving little margin for disappointment if bond yields stay elevated. This edition also includes an interview with Ondrej Konak, Co-Founder of NAVCalc, on building a fund-administration platform from scratch, earning client trust in critical processes, and freeing investment professionals from manual work. 👉 Read the full edition to explore all insights in detail.
